name: DeepSeekHarness
description: DeepSeek Harness is an open-source agent harness built on an everything-is-a-plugin architecture. It provides a web UI for running AI agents with file editing, shell access, and plugin extensibility.

notes.text: A DeepSeek API key is required. Add it under Settings > Models after the first login.
The startup URL printed in the container log includes the login token for the first session.
The web UI binds to the container IP fixed at install (DSH_WEB_HOST in /opt/deepseekharness/.env); wildcard binds are refused upstream, so update it if the IP changes.
